introHtml: Box matches mouse pads bring the nostalgic look of matchbook covers to your desktop. These unique pads are die-cut to resemble a matchbox, with a soft or firm surface for smooth tracking. Ideal for offices, trade shows, or corporate gifts, they offer a compact branding space that stands out. Choose from full-color imprint on soft or fabric surfaces to showcase your logo or message in a memorable way.
